title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：objective　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 objective 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the observer ① set the objective that no assistant in the observatory would have counted, and he said the setting was the whole of the night. The ② objective, meaning the aim itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed uncounted in the book; an objective, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ objective in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ objective at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An objective, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the observer said the counting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the objective was the whole of the matter, meaning the purpose and not the aim. The ⑥ objective, meaning the purpose and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; objective, he said, is either something you set or the only word that means both an aim and a purpose. He said the purpose is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ objective had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ objective of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of counting; objective, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ objective I remember is the aim counted in the log, which closed in 2000 and is still counted as the quietest in the observatory. An ⑩ objective, my mother said in 2002, is the only aim that improves by being counted; every objective, she said, is a purpose that has agreed to look like an aim. She said the purpose was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 目标；目的（指观测站里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 目标；目的（指那个目标本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：set the objective 定下这一个目标
D. n. 目标；目的（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 目标之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的目标之事）
F. n. 目标；目的（指观测记录里写到、被清点的那一个）
G. n. 目标、用意（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 用意（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: set the objective that no assistant in the observatory would have counted
The objective, meaning the aim itself and not the lens
the objective at the far dome
the objective was the whole of the matter
the objective had become a line in a log
The objective of the whole thing
An objective, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: set the objective 意为“定下这一个目标”，1993 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯清点的一个目标做了一遍。
objective 意为“目标；目的”，指那个目标本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被清点。
objective 意为“目标；目的”，指观测站里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
objective 意为“目标；目的”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
objective 意为“目标、用意”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个用意就是那件事的全部。
objective 意为“用意”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个目标，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
objective 意为“目标；目的”，指观测记录里写到、被清点的那一个，到 1998 年这一个成了观测记录里的一行。
objective 意为“目标之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的目标之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的清点。
objective 意为“目标；目的”，我记得的是观测记录里清点过的那一个，2000 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一个。
objective 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，目标是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的目标。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年那位观测员定下了观测站里没有一位助手肯清点的一个目标，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（set the objective）
那个目标，指的是那个目标本身而不是小小的镜片，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被清点。（objective）
那处观测站里每一个目标旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。（objective）
最远那座圆顶那个目标，指的是他们留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（objective）
叔叔说这个用意就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那个目标。（objective）
